summary.text: Shaila Tate is an independent candidate for Idaho State Senate District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Ron Taylor (D) and Republican Bryan Hyde.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked in the Idaho State Legislature for the last four years and is running outside the two major parties.

paragraphs.text: Tate earned an associate degree from Bradford Christian College in 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an independent candidate and said she is seeking the seat that covers Blaine, Lincoln and Jerome counties.

In the survey, Tate said her key messages include opposing abortion, closing federal and state borders and deporting people in the country illegally, and returning money to taxpayers through smaller government.
She also listed protecting gun rights and fighting for the next generation among her priorities.
